docs.title: Database API
docs.text:
frappe.db is the database connection of the current site. It is an instance of MariaDBDatabase, PostgresDatabase or SQLiteDatabase. All of them extend Database in frappe/database/database.py. On MariaDB, the default class is in frappe/database/mariadb/mysqlclient.py (mysqlclient driver). use_mysqlclient: 0 in site config selects the PyMySQL class in frappe/database/mariadb/database.py. That option is deprecated. Use this page to find a method and its exact signature. For usage, filters and transactions, see Database.

The signatures come from inspect.signature on a v16 site (MariaDB). Internal helpers are left out. frappe.db.db_type returns "mariadb", "postgres" or "sqlite".

Note

Methods on this page do not check permissions, unless the description says so. set_value, delete and sql do not run controller hooks.

docs.title: Read values
docs.text: Method Signature Description get_value (doctype: str, filters=None, fieldname='name', ignore=False, as_dict=False, debug=False, order_by='KEEP_DEFAULT_ORDERING', cache=False, for_update=False, *, run=True, pluck=False, distinct=False, skip_locked=False, wait=True) Return one value, or a tuple of values if fieldname is a list, from the first matching row. filters is a name, a dict or a list. Use None for a Single DocType. get_values (doctype: str, filters=None, fieldname='name', ignore=False, as_dict=False, debug=False, order_by='KEEP_DEFAULT_ORDERING', update=None, cache=False, for_update=False, *, run=True, pluck=False, distinct=False, limit=None, skip_locked=False, wait=True) Return values from all matching rows. get (doctype, filters=None, as_dict=True, cache=False) Return get_value with fieldname='*'. get_single_value (doctype: str, fieldname: str, cache: bool = True, *, debug=False, for_update=False, run=True) Return a field of a Single DocType, cast to its fieldtype. Cached in the request by default. get_singles_value (*args, **kwargs) Alias of get_single_value. get_singles_dict (doctype, debug=False, *, for_update=False, cast=False) Return all fields of a Single DocType as a dict. get_list (*args, **kwargs) Calls frappe.get_list. Checks permissions. get_all (*args, **kwargs) Calls frappe.get_all. Does not check permissions. exists (dt, dn=None, cache=False, *, debug=False) Return the name of a matching document, or None. dn is a name or a dict of filters. cache works only when dt and dn are strings. count (dt, filters=None, debug=False, cache=False, distinct: bool = True) Return COUNT(*) for the DocType and filters. estimate_count (doctype: str) -> int Return the estimated row count from table statistics. Cached in Redis for 60 minutes. a_row_exists (doctype) Return True if the table has at least one row. get_creation_count (doctype, minutes) Return the number of records created in the last minutes. get_last_created (doctype) Return the creation timestamp of the last record. get_descendants (doctype, name) Return the descendants of a group node in a tree DocType.

docs.title: Write values
docs.text: Method Signature Description set_value (dt: str, dn, field: str, val=None, modified=None, modified_by=None, update_modified=True, debug=False) Update columns with SQL. No controller hooks or validation. Updates modified and modified_by unless update_modified=False. field can be a dict of field and value. set_single_value (doctype: str, fieldname: str \| dict, value=None, *, modified=None, modified_by=None, update_modified=True, debug=False) Set fields of a Single DocType. bulk_update (doctype: str, doc_updates: dict, *, chunk_size=100, modified=None, modified_by=None, update_modified=True, debug=False) Update many documents. doc_updates maps each name to a dict of values. bulk_insert (doctype: str, fields: list[str], values: Iterable[Sequence], ignore_duplicates=False, *, chunk_size=1000) Insert many rows in one query per chunk. No controller hooks. delete (doctype: str, filters: dict \| list \| None = None, debug=False, **kwargs) Run DELETE for matching rows. No controller hooks. truncate (doctype: str) Run TRUNCATE TABLE. This is DDL and cannot be rolled back.

docs.title: Raw SQL and query builder
docs.text: Method Signature Description sql (query, values=<no value>, *, as_dict=0, as_list=0, debug=0, ignore_ddl=0, auto_commit=0, update=None, explain=False, run=True, pluck=False, as_iterator=False) Run a query and fetch all rows. Pass parameters in values, never with string formatting. query can also be a query builder object. sql_list (query, values=(), debug=False, **kwargs) Return the first column of each row as a list. sql_ddl (query, debug=False) Commit, then run a DDL query. multisql (sql_dict, values=(), **kwargs) Run the query for the current db_type from a dict like {"mariadb": ..., "postgres": ..., "*": ...}. mogrify (query, values) Return the query string with values substituted. escape (s, percent=True) Escape quotes, and % if percent=True. explain_query (query, values=<no value>) Print EXPLAIN of the query in the error log. unbuffered_cursor () Context manager. Use a cursor that streams rows instead of fetching all of them. get_description () Return the column metadata of the last query.

docs.title: Transactions
docs.text:
See Database for when Frappe commits for you.

Method Signature Description begin (*, read_only=False) Start a transaction. commit (*, chain=False) Commit and start a new transaction. Runs before_commit and after_commit callbacks. Inside read_only() it rolls back. rollback (*, save_point=None, chain=False) Roll back the transaction, or to a savepoint. savepoint (save_point) Make a savepoint. Rollback to it undoes only database changes, not files. release_savepoint (save_point) Release a savepoint. read_only () Context manager. Runs the block in a read-only transaction. The open transaction must have no writes. execution_timeout (seconds: float) Context manager. Sets a statement timeout for the block, then restores the old one. set_execution_timeout (seconds: float) Set the statement timeout of the session. get_execution_timeout () -> float Return the statement timeout in seconds. before_commit CallbackManager frappe.db.before_commit.add(fn) runs fn before the next commit. after_commit CallbackManager frappe.db.after_commit.add(fn) runs fn after the next commit. before_rollback CallbackManager Runs callbacks before the next rollback. after_rollback CallbackManager Runs callbacks after the next rollback.

frappe.database.database.savepoint(catch=Exception) is a context manager and decorator. It wraps a block in a savepoint and rolls back to it if catch is raised:

from frappe.database.database import savepoint

for name in ["Keyboard", "Monitor"]:
    with savepoint(catch=frappe.DuplicateEntryError):
        frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Sample Item", "item_name": name}).insert()

A key can have many values. get_global (key, user='__global') Return a global value. set_global (key, val, user='__global') Save a global value. get_system_setting (key) Return a value from System Settings.

docs.title: Error checks
docs.text:
Use these in except blocks to test a database error without database-specific codes. Each takes the exception and returns bool:

is_deadlocked, is_timedout, is_statement_timeout, is_read_only_mode_error, is_table_missing, is_missing_table, is_missing_column, is_missing_table_or_column, is_duplicate_entry, is_duplicate_fieldname, is_primary_key_violation, is_unique_key_violation, is_data_too_long, is_db_table_size_limit, is_syntax_error, is_access_denied, cant_drop_field_or_key, is_interface_error.

is_column_missing is deprecated. Use is_missing_column.

try:
    frappe.db.sql("insert into `tabSample Item` (name) values ('Keyboard')")
except Exception as e:
    if not frappe.db.is_duplicate_entry(e):
        raise

docs.title: Differences between databases
docs.text: Method MariaDB Postgres SQLite set_execution_timeout set session max_statement_time set local statement_timeout (ends with the transaction) PRAGMA busy_timeout add_index ALTER TABLE ... ADD INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. Adds a search_index Property Setter for a single field outside install and migrate CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS through sql_ddl. Strips lengths such as (10) from fields. No Property Setter CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. Strips lengths from fields. Adds the Property Setter like MariaDB bulk_insert Multi-row INSERT. ignore_duplicates calls the query builder ignore() Multi-row INSERT. ignore_duplicates adds ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING Multi-row INSERT. ignore_duplicates calls the query builder ignore() get_row_size Supported Raises NotImplementedError Raises NotImplementedError truncate TRUNCATE TABLE TRUNCATE TABLE DELETE FROM and resets sqlite_sequence

docs.title: JavaScript API
docs.text:
This page lists the client-side frappe namespaces that desk loads. Use it to find a function name and its arguments. The names come from Object.keys() on each namespace in a logged-in desk at /desk. The signatures come from the source files listed in the frontmatter. Internal helpers are left out.

For usage and examples, see Client API and Form Scripts.

Note

Functions that talk to the server return a Promise or a jQuery deferred. Await them, or pass a callback where the signature has one.

docs.title: Server calls
frappe.db
docs.text:
Each function calls a method in frappe.client or frappe.desk.reportview. Permissions of the current user apply.

Function Signature Description get_value (doctype, filters, fieldname, callback, parent_doc) Return field values of the first match. The result is in r.message. get_single_value (doctype, field) Resolve with one field of a Single DocType. get_list (doctype, { fields, filters, order_by, limit, ... }) Resolve with a list of records. Default fields is ["name"]. Default limit is 20. get_doc (doctype, name, filters) Resolve with the full document. Adds it to locals. exists (doctype, nameOrFilters) Resolve with true or false. count (doctype, { filters, limit } = {}, cache = false) Resolve with the number of matching records. insert (doc) Insert a new document. doc must have doctype. set_value (doctype, docname, fieldname, value, callback) Set one value, or many with a dict as fieldname. Saves the document on the server. delete_doc (doctype, name) Delete a document. get_link_options (doctype, txt = "", filters = {}, page_length = 0, include_image = false) Resolve with Link search results. 
const items = await frappe.db.get_list("Sample Item", {
    fields: ["name", "rate"],
    filters: { category: "Hardware" },
    limit: 2,
});
// [{ name: "Keyboard", rate: 45 }, { name: "Monitor", rate: 250 }]

docs.text: Function Signature Description frappe.msgprint (msg, title, is_minimizable, re_route) Show a message dialog. msg can be an object with message, title, indicator, primary_action. frappe.throw (msg) Show a red message, then throw an Error. frappe.show_alert (message, seconds = 7, actions = {}) Show a toast. message can be { message, indicator }. frappe.toast same as show_alert Alias of show_alert. frappe.confirm (message, confirm_action, reject_action, primary_label, secondary_label) Show a Yes and No dialog. frappe.warn (title, message_html, proceed_action, primary_label, is_minimizable, secondary_label) Show a warning dialog with a proceed button. frappe.prompt (fields, callback, title, primary_label) Ask for values in a dialog. fields is one field definition or a list. frappe.show_progress (title, count, total = 100, description, hide_on_completion = false) Show or update a progress dialog. frappe.hide_progress () Close the progress dialog. frappe.hide_msgprint (instant) Close the message dialog. frappe.verify_password (callback) Ask the user for their password, then call callback.

docs.title: frappe.ui.Dialog
docs.text:
new frappe.ui.Dialog(opts) makes a dialog. Dialog extends frappe.ui.FieldGroup.

Option Description title Dialog title. fields List of field definitions (fieldname, fieldtype, label, options, reqd, default, ...). size "small", "large" or "extra-large". primary_action_label, primary_action(values) Main button. values comes from get_values(). secondary_action_label, secondary_action Second button. minimizable Allow the user to minimize the dialog. Method Description show(), hide() Open or close the dialog. get_values(ignore_errors, check_invalid) Return field values. Returns nothing if a mandatory field is empty. get_value(key), set_value(key, val), set_values(dict) Read or set fields. get_field(fieldname) Return the control of a field. set_df_property(fieldname, prop, value) Change a field property. set_query(fieldname, opt1, opt2) Set the query of a Link field. set_primary_action(label, click) Change the main button. disable_primary_action(), enable_primary_action() Toggle the main button. set_title(t), set_message(text), set_alert(text, alert_class = "info") Change title, message or alert. clear() Clear all values. add_custom_action(label, action, css_class) Add a button to the footer. 
const d = new frappe.ui.Dialog({
    title: __("New Sample Item"),
    fields: [
        { fieldname: "item_name", fieldtype: "Data", label: __("Item Name"), reqd: 1 },
        { fieldname: "rate", fieldtype: "Currency", label: __("Rate") },
    ],
    primary_action_label: __("Create"),
    primary_action(values) {
        frappe.db.insert({ doctype: "Sample Item", ...values }).then(() => d.hide());
    },
});
d.show();

docs.title: frappe.model
docs.text:
Documents in the browser live in locals[doctype][name].

Function Signature Description get_doc (doctype, name) Return a document from locals. Also frappe.get_doc. get_list (doctype, filters) Return documents in locals that match. Also frappe.get_list. with_doctype (doctype, callback, async) Load DocType metadata, then call callback. Returns a Promise. with_doc (doctype, name, callback, error_callback) Load a document into locals. Returns a Promise. get_new_doc (doctype, parent_doc, parentfield, with_mandatory_children) Make a new local document with defaults. Its name starts with new-. add_child (parent_doc, doctype, parentfield, idx) Add a child row to a local document. clear_table (doc, parentfield) Remove all rows of a child table. copy_doc (doc, from_amend, parent_doc, parentfield) Make a local copy of a document. set_value (doctype, docname, fieldname, value, fieldtype, skip_dirty_trigger = false) Set a value on a local document and run change triggers. get_value (doctype, filters, fieldname, callback) Read from locals. With a callback, read from the server. delete_doc (doctype, docname, callback) Ask, then delete on the server. rename_doc (doctype, docname, callback) Open the rename dialog. open_mapped_doc (opts) Call a mapper method (opts.method, opts.frm) and open the new document. round_floats_in (doc, fieldnames) Round float fields to their precision. get_doc_title (doc) Return the title of a document. is_submittable, is_table, is_single, is_tree (doctype) Check DocType flags. can_read, can_write, can_create, can_delete, can_submit, can_cancel (doctype) Check the user permission on a DocType. can_print, can_email, can_export, can_import, can_share (doctype, frm) Check other rights. has_workflow (doctype) Return true if the DocType has an active workflow. scrub, unscrub (txt) Same as the Python helpers.

frappe.get_meta(doctype) returns the metadata from locals.DocType. It returns undefined until the DocType is loaded. Call frappe.model.with_doctype first.

frappe.realtime is a RealTimeClient (Socket.IO). See Realtime.

docs.title: Dates and times
docs.text:
frappe.datetime. Strings are in yyyy-mm-dd (system format) unless the name says user.

Function Signature Description get_today () Today as yyyy-mm-dd. nowdate () Same as get_today. now_date / now_time / now_datetime (as_obj = false) Now in the user time zone. system_datetime (as_obj = false) Now in the system time zone. add_days (d, days) Add days. add_months (d, months) Add months. get_diff / get_day_diff (d1, d2) Days between d1 and d2 (d1 minus d2). get_hour_diff / get_minute_diff (d1, d2) Hours or minutes between two datetimes. str_to_obj / obj_to_str (d) String to Date, Date to string. str_to_user (val, only_time = false, only_date = false) System format to user format. user_to_str (val, only_time = false) User format to system format. user_to_obj / obj_to_user (d) Convert between user format and Date. month_start / month_end () First or last day of this month. week_start / week_end, quarter_start / quarter_end, year_start / year_end () Boundaries of this week, quarter or year. global_date_format (d) Localized long date. comment_when (datetime, mini) Relative time HTML, for example 2 hours ago. prettyDate (date, mini) Relative time text. convert_to_user_tz / convert_to_system_tz (date, format) Convert between time zones. get_user_date_fmt / get_user_time_fmt / get_user_fmt () Format strings of the user. validate (d) Return true if the value is a valid date. 
frappe.datetime.add_days("2026-01-31", 1);              // "2026-02-01"
frappe.datetime.get_day_diff("2026-03-01", "2026-02-01"); // 28
frappe.datetime.str_to_user("2026-01-15");              // "15-01-2026" with date format dd-mm-yyyy

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
This page lists the public names on the frappe module. Use it to find the exact name and signature of a function. The list comes from dir(frappe), read with inspect.signature on a v16 site. Internal helpers, re-exported standard library modules and exception classes are left out.

Many names are defined in other modules. frappe/__init__.py imports them at module level, for example get_doc from frappe.model.document and enqueue from frappe.utils.background_jobs. They load when frappe is imported.

For frappe.db methods, see Database API. For frappe.utils helpers, see Utilities.

docs.title: Context objects
docs.text:
These are request-local objects. They are proxies to frappe.local and are valid only after frappe.init() and frappe.connect().

Name Type Description frappe.local Local Thread-local and request-local storage. All objects below live on it. frappe.db LocalProxy to Database Database connection of the current site. See Database API. frappe.qb LocalProxy Query builder for the current database type. See Query Builder. frappe.session LocalProxy Current session. frappe.session.user is the name of the current user. frappe.user LocalProxy Always None. frappe.set_user does not set it. Use frappe.session.user. frappe.form_dict LocalProxy (_dict) Request parameters (query string and form body). frappe.form LocalProxy Alias of frappe.form_dict. frappe.request LocalProxy The Werkzeug request object. frappe.response LocalProxy (_dict) Response dict. Whitelisted methods put their return value in frappe.response["message"]. frappe.flags LocalProxy (_dict) Request-scoped flags, for example frappe.flags.in_import, frappe.flags.in_migrate. frappe.conf LocalProxy (_dict) Merged site_config.json and common_site_config.json. See Configuration. frappe.lang LocalProxy Language code of the current request. frappe.message_log LocalProxy (list) Messages queued by frappe.msgprint. frappe.error_log LocalProxy (list) Errors queued by frappe.errprint. frappe.debug_log LocalProxy (list) Lines queued by frappe.log. frappe.job LocalProxy Current background job info, if the code runs in a worker. frappe.cache RedisWrapper Redis cache client. See Caching. frappe.client_cache ClientCache In-process cache in front of Redis for values that rarely change. frappe.in_test bool True while tests run. frappe.STANDARD_USERS tuple ("Guest", "Administrator"). Function Signature Description frappe.init (site: str, sites_path: str = '.', new_site: bool = False, force: bool = False, *, is_request=False, is_job=False) -> None Initialize frappe for a site. Resets frappe.local. frappe.connect (site: str \| None = None, db_name: str \| None = None, set_admin_as_user: bool = True) -> None Connect to the site database. Passing site or db_name is deprecated. Call frappe.init(site) first. frappe.connect_replica () -> bool Connect to the read replica set in site config. frappe.destroy () Close the database connection and release frappe.local. frappe.set_user (username: str) Set the current user. Clears cached user permissions. frappe.get_user () Return a UserPermissions object for the session user. frappe.get_roles (username=None) -> list[str] Return the roles of a user. Default is the session user. frappe.get_request_header (key, default=None) Return an HTTP request header. frappe.get_site_config (sites_path: str \| None = None, site_path: str \| None = None, *, cached=False) -> _dict Return site_config.json merged with common_site_config.json. frappe.get_common_site_config (sites_path: str \| None = None, cached=False) -> _dict Return common_site_config.json. frappe.get_conf (site: str \| None = None) -> _dict Return the config of a site. frappe.get_system_settings (key: str) Return one value from System Settings. frappe.get_website_settings (key) Return one value from Website Settings. frappe.get_site_path (*joins) Return the path of the current site folder, joined with joins. frappe.is_setup_complete () Return True if the setup wizard is complete. Cached per request. frappe.ping () Return "pong". frappe.logger (module=None, with_more_info=False, allow_site=True, filter=None, max_size=100000, file_count=20) -> Logger Return a Python logger that writes to the bench log folder. frappe.log (msg: str) -> None Add a line to frappe.debug_log. frappe.errprint (msg: str) -> None Add an error line. It is sent back as exc in the response. frappe.print_sql (enable: bool = True) -> None Print every SQL query to the console. Use it to debug.

docs.title: Documents
docs.text:
See Controllers for the Document class and its lifecycle.

Function Signature Description frappe.get_doc (doctype, name, /, *, for_update=None, check_permission=None) or (doctype, /) or (dict) Return a Document. With a name, load it from the database. With a Single DocType name, load the Single. With a dict, make a new unsaved document. frappe.new_doc (doctype: str, *, parent_doc=None, parentfield=None, as_dict=False, **kwargs) -> Document Return a new document with defaults set. Extra kwargs set field values. frappe.get_lazy_doc (doctype: str, name: str, *, for_update=None, check_permission=None) -> Document Same as get_doc, but loads child tables on first access. frappe.get_cached_doc (*args, **kwargs) -> Document Same as get_doc, but return a copy from the cache if present. frappe.get_last_doc (doctype, filters=None, order_by='creation desc', *, for_update=False) Return the last created document that matches the filters. frappe.get_single (doctype) Return the document of a Single DocType. frappe.copy_doc (doc: Document, ignore_no_copy: bool = True) -> Document Return an unsaved copy of a document. Clears name, owner, creation, modified, modified_by. frappe.delete_doc (doctype=None, name=None, force=False, ignore_doctypes=None, for_reload=False, ignore_permissions=False, flags=None, ignore_on_trash=False, ignore_missing=True, delete_permanently=False) Delete a document. Calls frappe.model.delete_doc.delete_doc. frappe.delete_doc_if_exists same as delete_doc Delete a document if it exists. frappe.rename_doc (doctype: str, old, new, force=False, merge=False, *, ignore_if_exists=False, show_alert=True, rebuild_search=True) -> str Rename a document and update all Link fields that point to it. frappe.get_meta (doctype, cached: bool = True) -> Meta Return the metadata (DocType with custom fields and property setters applied). frappe.get_meta_module (doctype) Return the Python module of a DocType controller. frappe.is_table (doctype: str) -> bool Return True if the DocType is a child table (istable). frappe.get_doctype_app (doctype) Return the app that owns a DocType. frappe.get_precision (doctype: str, fieldname: str, currency: str \| None = None, doc=None) -> int Return the precision of a Float, Currency or Percent field. frappe.clear_document_cache (doctype: str, name: str \| None = None) -> None Remove a document from the document cache. frappe.reload_doc (module: str, dt=None, dn=None, force=False, reset_permissions=False) Reload a DocType or record from its JSON file in the module. Use it in patches. frappe.reload_doctype (doctype, force=False, reset_permissions=False) Reload a DocType from its JSON file. frappe.import_doc (path) Import documents from a JSON file, or every JSON file in a folder. Mutes emails while it runs. frappe.make_property_setter (args, ignore_validate=False, validate_fields_for_doctype=True, is_system_generated=True, *, module=None) Make a Property Setter that overrides a DocType or DocField property.

docs.title: Queries
docs.text:
See Database for filter syntax.

Function Signature Description frappe.get_list (doctype, *args, **kwargs) Return records as a list of dicts. Applies permissions of the current user. There is no default limit: it returns all matching rows unless you pass limit. The docstring says 20. frappe.get_all (doctype, *args, **kwargs) Same as get_list, but does not check permissions. Default fields is ["name"]. frappe.get_value (*args, **kwargs) Alias of frappe.db.get_value. frappe.get_cached_value (doctype: str, name, fieldname='name', as_dict=False) Return field values from the cached document. Returns None if the document does not exist. frappe.get_single_value (setting: str, fieldname: str, /, *, as_dict=False) Return a cached value from a Single DocType. frappe.set_value (doctype, docname, fieldname, value=None) Set a value through frappe.client.set_value. Runs validations and saves the document. frappe.get_query (*args, **kwargs) -> QueryBuilder Build a query builder object from doctype, fields and filters. See Query Builder. frappe.get_query_builder (type_of_db: str) Return the query builder class for mariadb, postgres or sqlite.

docs.title: Messages and errors
docs.text:
Function Signature Description frappe.msgprint (msg, title=None, raise_exception=False, as_table=False, as_list=False, indicator=None, alert=False, primary_action=None, is_minimizable=False, wide=False, *, realtime=False, allow_dangerous_html=False) -> None Queue a message for the user. It is sent in __server_messages of the response. frappe.throw (msg, exc=ValidationError, title=None, is_minimizable=False, wide=False, as_list=False, primary_action=None, *, allow_dangerous_html=False) -> None Show a message and raise exc. frappe.toast (message: str, indicator=None) Show a short alert to the user. indicator is blue, green, orange, red or yellow. frappe.throw_permission_error () Raise frappe.PermissionError with the standard message. frappe.clear_messages () Clear all queued messages. frappe.clear_last_message () Remove the last queued message. frappe.get_message_log () -> list[dict] Return the queued messages. frappe.log_error (title=None, message=None, reference_doctype=None, reference_name=None, *, defer_insert=False) -> ErrorLog Make an Error Log. Without message, logs the current traceback. frappe.get_traceback (with_context: bool = False) -> str Return the traceback of the current exception. frappe.respond_as_web_page (title, html, success=None, http_status_code=None, context=None, indicator_color=None, primary_action='/', primary_label=None, fullpage=False, width=None, template='message') Send the response as an HTML message page, not JSON. frappe.redirect_to_message (title, html, http_status_code=None, context=None, indicator_color=None) Redirect to /message?id=... and show a message page. frappe.redirect (url) Raise frappe.Redirect, which sends a 301 redirect to url.

Exception classes such as frappe.ValidationError, frappe.PermissionError, frappe.DoesNotExistError, frappe.DuplicateEntryError, frappe.MandatoryError, frappe.LinkValidationError and frappe.TimestampMismatchError come from frappe/exceptions.py.

See Whitelisted Methods.

docs.title: REST Endpoints Reference
docs.text: This page lists every route that Frappe serves under /api, and the core whitelisted methods that clients call most. For how to authenticate, filter and page, see REST API and Authentication.

docs.title: Route maps
docs.text:
frappe/api/__init__.py mounts three route sets:

Prefix Rules from Response key /api/ frappe/api/v1.py message for methods, data for resources /api/v1/ frappe/api/v1.py (same rules) same as /api/ /api/v2/ frappe/api/v2.py data for all routes. Errors are in errors

Trailing slashes are optional. When System Settings log_api_requests is on, each call writes an API Request Log. All routes run as the session user. Permission checks are those of the called function. An HTTP method that a route does not list returns HTTP 405.

docs.title: API v1
API v2
docs.text:
Route HTTP methods Does Permission check /api/v2/method/login any Log in with usr and pwd. The login runs in LoginManager before the route. none /api/v2/method/logout POST Log out the session. none /api/v2/method/ping any Returns "pong". none /api/v2/method/upload_file POST Upload a file. Same as frappe.handler.upload_file. see Files /api/v2/method/run_doc_method GET, POST Run a whitelisted method on a document dict that need not be saved. Args: method, document, kwargs. read (GET), write or create (POST) /api/v2/method/<dotted.path> any allowed by the method Calls a whitelisted function or API Server Script. Applies override_whitelisted_methods. @frappe.whitelist rules /api/v2/method/<doctype>/<method> any allowed by the method Calls a whitelisted module function in the DocType's controller file. @frappe.whitelist rules /api/v2/document/<doctype> GET List records. Returns data and has_next_page. query permission rules /api/v2/document/<doctype> POST Insert a document from the JSON body. create /api/v2/document/<doctype>/<name> GET Read one document. read /api/v2/document/<doctype>/<name> PATCH, PUT Update fields and save. write /api/v2/document/<doctype>/<name> DELETE Delete. Returns HTTP 202 and "ok". delete /api/v2/document/<doctype>/<name>/copy GET A copy of the document without name and other private properties, ready to insert. The route keeps no_copy fields. read /api/v2/document/<doctype>/<name>/method/<method> GET, POST Call a whitelisted controller method. The saved document goes in docs. read (GET), write (POST) /api/v2/doctype/<doctype>/meta GET DocType meta. logged-in user (frappe.only_for("All")) /api/v2/doctype/<doctype>/count GET Count with optional filters. frappe.desk.reportview.get_count rules

List parameters for GET /api/v2/document/<doctype>: fields, filters (list or dict), order_by, group_by, start (default 0), limit (default 20), as_dict (default true), debug. A controller can change the list query with a static get_list(query) method that returns a query builder object.

curl -b cookies.txt -X POST http://frappe.localhost:8006/api/v2/document/ToDo \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"description": "Sample REST todo"}'
curl -b cookies.txt -X PATCH http://frappe.localhost:8006/api/v2/document/ToDo/2nvhphpj3b \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status": "Closed"}'
curl -b cookies.txt "http://frappe.localhost:8006/api/v2/doctype/ToDo/count"

{"data": 4}

Version

v16 has no v2 bulk routes (bulk_delete, bulk_update) and does not accept the QUERY HTTP method. Use frappe.client.bulk_update for many updates.

docs.title: API discovery
docs.text:
All discovery routes need the Desk User role. They are GET only.

Route Returns /api/v2/discovery Counts of methods and DocType methods, and links to the routes below. /api/v2/discovery/search?q=<text> Up to 50 methods whose text has every word of q. /api/v2/discovery/method All whitelisted methods the user can call. /api/v2/discovery/method/<dotted.path> One method: parameters, HTTP methods, docstring, and source when the app sets expose_discovery_source. /api/v2/discovery/doctype/<doctype> Whitelisted controller methods of a DocType. /api/v2/discovery/doctype/<doctype>/method/<method> One controller method.

The discovery index is kept in the Redis cache for one hour. When the index is missing, the route enqueues a build job on the long queue and returns HTTP 503 DiscoveryCacheUnavailable. Try again after a few seconds. A background worker must run for the build to finish. See MCP and Discovery.

docs.title: MCP
docs.text:
Route HTTP methods Does /api/v2/mcp POST (GET and DELETE return 405) Model Context Protocol server over streamable HTTP with JSON responses.

The route returns 404 unless System Settings enable_mcp is on. A Guest request gets HTTP 401. A user without the Desk User role gets HTTP 403. The request needs Content-Type: application/json (else 415) and an Accept header that allows application/json (else 406). Tools: search_doctypes, get_doctype_schema, search_methods, get_method_schema, list_document_methods, list_documents, get_document, count_documents, create_document, update_document, delete_document, call_method, call_document_method. Each tool runs with the permissions of the user.

docs.title: Login, logout and files
docs.text:
These work on /api/method/... (v1). In v2, use the routes in the v2 table.

Method path HTTP methods Guest Description login POST yes Log in. Args: usr, pwd. Returns message, home_page, full_name and sets the sid cookie. logout POST yes Log out the current session. frappe.handler.web_logout POST yes Log out and show a "Logged Out" web page. frappe.auth.get_logged_user any no Returns the user name of the session. frappe.ping any yes Returns "pong". upload_file (frappe.handler.upload_file) POST yes Upload a file as multipart form data (file, doctype, docname, fieldname, is_private, folder, file_url). frappe.handler.download_file any yes Download a file by file_url, with session or token auth. frappe.core.doctype.user.user.reset_password POST yes Send a password reset link. Arg: user. frappe.core.doctype.user.user.update_password POST yes Set a new password with key or old_password. frappe.core.doctype.user.user.sign_up any yes Website sign up. Args: email, full_name, redirect_to.

Short names such as logout and upload_file resolve to frappe.handler and are deprecated. Use the full dotted path in new code.

curl -c cookies.txt -X POST http://frappe.localhost:8006/api/method/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"usr": "Administrator", "pwd": "password"}'

{"message": "Logged In", "home_page": "desk", "full_name": "Administrator"}

docs.title: frappe.client methods
docs.text:
Call them as /api/method/frappe.client.<name> or /api/v2/method/frappe.client.<name>. Defined in frappe/client.py. "any" means GET, POST, PUT and DELETE. This is the default of @frappe.whitelist().

Method HTTP methods Arguments Description get_list any doctype, fields, filters, or_filters, group_by, order_by, limit_start, limit_page_length (20), parent, as_dict, expand, debug List records with permission checks. get_count any doctype, filters, cache, debug Count records. get any doctype, name or filters, parent Get one document as a dict. get_value any doctype, fieldname (str or list), filters, as_dict, parent Get field values of one record. get_single_value any doctype, field Get a field of a Single DocType. set_value POST, PUT doctype, name, fieldname (str or dict), value Set values and save the document. insert POST, PUT doc Insert a document. A child row needs parenttype, parent, parentfield. insert_many POST, PUT docs Insert many documents. save POST, PUT doc Save an existing document. rename_doc POST, PUT doctype, old_name, new_name, merge Rename a document. submit POST, PUT doc Submit a document. cancel POST, PUT doctype, name Cancel a submitted document. delete DELETE, POST doctype, name Delete a document. bulk_update POST, PUT docs Update many documents. Each item has doctype, docname and fields. has_permission any doctype, docname, perm_type (read) Returns {"has_permission": bool}. get_doc_permissions any doctype, docname Returns {"permissions": {...}}. Empty when the user cannot read the document. get_password any doctype, name, fieldname Returns a decrypted Password field. System Manager only. get_time_zone any (guest) none Returns the system time zone. attach_file POST, PUT filename, filedata, doctype, docname, folder, decode_base64, is_private, docfield Attach file content to a document. is_document_amended any doctype, docname True when an amended copy exists. validate_link_and_fetch GET, POST doctype, docname, fields_to_fetch, query, filters Check a Link value and fetch fields from the linked record. 
curl -b cookies.txt "http://frappe.localhost:8006/api/v2/method/frappe.client.get_value?doctype=User&filters=%22Administrator%22&fieldname=%5B%22full_name%22%5D"

{"data": {"full_name": "Administrator"}}

docs.title: Other core methods
docs.text:
The desk calls these. They are useful for clients too.

Method HTTP methods Description frappe.desk.reportview.get any List view data. Args like get_list (doctype, fields, filters, order_by, start, page_length). frappe.desk.reportview.get_count any Count for list view. frappe.desk.reportview.export_query any Export Report Builder data as CSV or Excel. frappe.desk.reportview.delete_items POST, DELETE Delete selected records. frappe.desk.form.load.getdoc any Load a document with docinfo for the form. frappe.desk.form.load.getdoctype any Load DocType meta and scripts for the form. frappe.desk.form.save.savedocs POST, PUT Save, submit or update a document from the form. Args: doc, action. frappe.desk.form.save.cancel POST, PUT Cancel from the form. frappe.desk.search.search_link any Results for a Link field dropdown. frappe.desk.query_report.run any Run a Query or Script Report. Args: report_name, filters. frappe.rename_doc POST, PUT Rename and update links.

frappe has about 720 whitelisted methods in this version. To list them, call /api/v2/discovery/method as a desk user. App developers make new ones with @frappe.whitelist(). See Whitelisted Methods.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• A method without methods= in @frappe.whitelist accepts GET, POST, PUT and DELETE. Write methods should set methods=["POST"].
  • v1 PUT /api/resource/... and v2 PATCH call doc.save(). They do not submit. Use the submit method or a document method.
  • v2 list returns 20 records by default. Check has_next_page and raise start.
  • frappe.client.get_list and /api/resource return 20 rows by default. limit_page_length=0 removes the limit. Use it with care on large tables.
  • run_doc_method in v2 loads the saved copy of the document by name. Send a name (for example new-todo-1) also for an unsaved document. Without it, the call fails with "not found".

docs.title: Utilities
docs.text:
frappe.utils holds helpers for type conversion, dates, numbers, formatting, strings, URLs and files. Most of them live in frappe/utils/data.py and are re-exported from frappe.utils. Import them from frappe.utils:

from frappe.utils import cint, flt, getdate, add_days, nowdate

The signatures come from inspect.signature on a v16 site. Type hints are shortened. DateTimeLikeObject means str | datetime.date | datetime.datetime. Helpers in other modules show the full import path.

docs.title: Example output
docs.text:
These results come from a v16 site with date format dd-mm-yyyy, number format #,##,###.## and currency precision not set:

from frappe.utils import cint, flt, cstr, getdate, add_days, date_diff, add_to_date, get_last_day, comma_and

cint("12.7")                      # 12
cint("abc")                       # 0
cint(None, 5)                     # 5
flt("1,234.567", 2)               # 1234.57
cstr(None)                        # ''
getdate("2026-01-15")             # datetime.date(2026, 1, 15)
add_days("2026-01-31", 1)         # '2026-02-01'  (string in, string out)
add_days(getdate("2026-01-31"), 1)  # datetime.date(2026, 2, 1)
date_diff("2026-03-01", "2026-02-01")  # 28
add_to_date("2026-01-31", months=1)    # '2026-02-28'
get_last_day("2026-02-14")        # datetime.date(2026, 2, 28)
comma_and(["a", "b", "c"])        # "'a', 'b', and 'c'"

docs.title: CLI Reference
docs.text: This page lists every bench command that the frappe app adds, in this version. The list and the options come from the click definitions in frappe/commands/ and the Studio and Flow command modules. Commands of the bench tool itself (init, get-app, new-app, start, setup ...) are not on this page. Run all commands from the bench root (frappe-bench/).

docs.title: How commands find the site
docs.text:
bench loads frappe.commands.commands and the commands list of every other app (<app>/commands/__init__.py or <app>/commands.py). It wraps them in one group that takes these options before the command name:

Option Description --site <site> Site to run on. --site all runs on every site, for commands that loop over sites. --verbose Verbose output. --force Force flag. Some commands read it (for example run-patch, reload-doc). --profile Run the command under cProfile and print the top 100 lines.

When --site is not given, bench uses the FRAPPE_SITE environment variable, then default_site from common_site_config.json (set with bench use <site>).

bench --site frappe.localhost migrate
bench --site all clear-cache
bench --site frappe.localhost execute frappe.client.get_count --args '["ToDo"]'

In the tables below, "Needs site" means:

  • Yes: the command runs on the site from --site (or the default site). Without one, it fails with "Please specify --site sitename".
  • Optional: the command also works without a site, or takes --site after the command name.
  • No: the command does not use a site.

Run bench <command> --help to see the same options on your bench. Commands in a group (flow-server) take the subcommand next: bench flow-server status.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Put global options before the command: bench --site s1 migrate, not bench migrate --site s1. Only commands that define their own --site (for example doctor, show-pending-jobs, build-studio-app) accept it after the name.

docs.title: Hooks Reference
docs.text: This page lists every key in an app's hooks.py that the framework reads in this version. Use it to look up the shape of a hook value and the code that reads it. For how hooks work and how values from many apps merge, see Hooks.

docs.title: How to read this page
docs.text:
• frappe.get_hooks("key") collects the key from all active apps and returns a list. A single string value becomes a one-item list.
  • A dict value is merged key by key. Each inner value also becomes a list. For example, doc_events["*"]["on_update"] is a list of dotted paths from all apps.
  • "Last wins" means the framework uses only the last item ([-1]). Apps load in install order, so the app installed last wins.
  • "All run" means the framework calls every dotted path in the list, in app order.
  • "Per app" means the framework reads the key with app_name=<app> and uses only that app's value.
  • Paths in the "Read in" column are relative to apps/frappe.

The Audit System Hooks report (frappe/custom/report/audit_system_hooks) shows the merged value of each hook on a site. In code, check a value from the console:

frappe.get_hooks("calendars")   # ['Event']

docs.title: App metadata
docs.text:
Key Shape Read in Description app_name str frappe/utils/boilerplate.py Python package name of the app. Written by bench new-app. app_title str frappe/boot.py, frappe/utils/change_log.py, frappe/email/email_body.py, frappe/gettext/translate.py Display name. Used on the apps screen, in version info, in .pot headers and as the email header title (last wins). app_publisher str frappe/modules/utils.py, frappe/gettext/translate.py Copyright holder in boilerplate files and .pot headers. Per app. app_description str frappe/utils/change_log.py Description shown in version info. Per app. app_email str frappe/gettext/translate.py Bug report address in the .pot catalog header. Per app. app_license str frappe/utils/boilerplate.py License name. Only the boilerplate generator uses it. app_color str frappe/utils/change_log.py App color in version info. Per app. app_logo_url str frappe/boot.py, frappe/core/doctype/navbar_settings/navbar_settings.py, frappe/utils/change_log.py Logo of the app. The navbar uses the second logo when exactly two apps set one. app_home str frappe/boot.py Route of the app home, for example /desk/build. Per app. <branch>_version str frappe/utils/change_log.py Version label for a branch, for example develop_version. Shown when the app is not on master. add_to_apps_screen list of dict frappe/apps.py, frappe/boot.py, frappe/desk/doctype/desktop_icon/desktop_icon.py, frappe/desk/doctype/dock/dock.py Adds the app to the apps screen. Keys: name, logo, title, route, desk_route, has_permission (dotted path), sequence_id, setup_wizard_text. required_apps list of str frappe/installer.py, frappe/core/doctype/installed_applications/installed_applications.py Apps to install before this app. bench install-app installs them first. code_only_modules dict: module -> list of modules frappe/utils/modules.py Modules that hold code only. They are kept out of the dock, and their navigation goes to the listed heir modules. 
# sample_app/hooks.py
app_name = "sample_app"
app_title = "Sample App"
app_publisher = "Example Corp"
required_apps = ["frappe"]
add_to_apps_screen = [
    {
        "name": "sample_app",
        "logo": "/assets/sample_app/logo.svg",
        "title": "Sample App",
        "route": "/desk/sample-item",
        "has_permission": "sample_app.api.check_app_permission",
    }
]

docs.title: App lifecycle (install, migrate, enable, build, tests)
docs.text:
All keys in this table are lists of dotted paths. "Per app" keys run only the hooks of the app that the event is about.

Key Read in Called with Description before_install frappe/installer.py nothing Per app. Runs before the app is installed. If a function returns False, the install stops. after_install frappe/installer.py nothing Per app. Runs after the app's DocTypes and fixtures sync. after_sync frappe/installer.py nothing Per app. Runs at the end of install_app. before_app_install frappe/installer.py app_name All apps. Runs before any app is installed. after_app_install frappe/installer.py app_name All apps. Runs after any app is installed. before_uninstall frappe/installer.py nothing Per app. Runs before the app is removed. after_uninstall frappe/installer.py nothing Per app. Runs after the app is removed. before_app_uninstall frappe/installer.py app_name All apps. Runs before any app is removed. after_app_uninstall frappe/installer.py app_name All apps. Runs after any app is removed. before_migrate frappe/migrate.py nothing Per app. Runs at the start of bench migrate. after_migrate frappe/migrate.py nothing Per app. Runs at the end of bench migrate. after_build frappe/commands/utils.py nothing Per app. Runs after bench build for the apps that were built. after_app_build frappe/commands/utils.py list of built apps Per app, for every app on the bench. Runs after a build. before_tests frappe/testing/environment.py, frappe/parallel_test_runner.py nothing Per app. Runs before the tests of the app. never_skip_patches frappe/modules/patch_handler.py not called Patch paths (or prefixes) that bench migrate --skip-failing cannot skip. A failure in one stops the migrate. fixtures frappe/utils/fixtures.py, frappe/translate.py not called Records to export with bench export-fixtures and import on migrate. Items are DocType names or dicts with doctype, filters, or_filters. fixture_auto_order frappe/utils/fixtures.py not called True adds a numeric prefix to exported fixture files, in the order of fixtures. Per app. importable_doctypes frappe/model/sync.py not called Extra DocTypes whose records in module folders (<module>/<doctype>/<name>/<name>.json) import on migrate. 
# sample_app/hooks.py
after_install = "sample_app.setup.install.after_install"
after_migrate = ["sample_app.setup.install.sync_defaults"]
fixtures = [{"doctype": "Custom Field", "filters": [["module", "=", "Sample App"]]}]

docs.title: Site Config Reference
docs.text: This page lists every key in site_config.json and common_site_config.json that the framework reads in this version. For how the two files merge, how to set keys and how environment variables override them, see Configuration.

docs.title: How to read this page
docs.text:
• Frappe reads sites/common_site_config.json first, then sites/<site>/site_config.json. A site key overrides a common key with the same name. The result is frappe.conf (same object as frappe.local.conf).
  • Scope "Common" means the key is read without a site (through frappe.get_common_site_config(), or frappe.get_conf() outside a site). Set it in common_site_config.json. "Site" keys work in either file.
  • "Default" is the value the code uses when the key is missing. An empty cell means the feature is off or the value is empty.
  • Set a key with bench --site <site> set-config <key> <value>, or bench set-config -g <key> <value> for the common file. Add -p to parse the value as JSON or a Python literal.
bench --site frappe.localhost set-config developer_mode 1
bench set-config -g redis_cache "redis://127.0.0.1:13000"
bench --site frappe.localhost set-config -p allow_cors '["https://app.example.com"]'

In code, read a key from frappe.conf. A missing key returns None.

frappe.conf.developer_mode      # 1 or None
frappe.conf.get("max_file_size")

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• frappe.conf is cached for up to 60 seconds in long-running processes. Restart workers after you change Redis or database keys.
  • A key in site_config.json hides the same key in common_site_config.json.
  • The auth_method key for the site config email account is not read. The code passes ("auth_method"), a string, not a tuple, so it looks up each character.

docs.title: DocTypes Reference
docs.text:
This page lists every DocType that the frappe app ships, grouped by module. Use it to find the exact DocType name and its module. The list is generated from frappe/*/doctype/*/*.json. It has 332 DocTypes, the same as the count of non-custom DocTypes on a v16 site.

Flags come from the DocType JSON:

Flag JSON property Meaning single issingle One record only. Values are in tabSingles. child istable Child table. Rows belong to a parent document. submittable is_submittable Has Submit and Cancel (docstatus). tree is_tree Nested set tree with lft and rgt. virtual is_virtual No table. The controller supplies the data.

For child tables, the description names the parent DocType and the Table field. See DocTypes for how DocTypes work.

docs.title: Field Types
docs.text: The fieldtype of a DocField sets the database column, the desk control and the validation of a field. Use this page to choose a fieldtype and to set its options. The list of fieldtypes comes from the fieldtype options in frappe/core/doctype/docfield/docfield.json. Column types come from setup_type_map() of each database class.

docs.title: Groups of fieldtypes
docs.text:
frappe/model/__init__.py defines these groups:

Constant Fieldtypes Meaning data_fieldtypes All types with a column, from Currency to JSON in the table below Each field of these types gets a column in tab<DocType>. no_value_fields Section Break, Column Break, Tab Break, Attachment Gallery, HTML, Table, Table MultiSelect, Button, Image, Fold, Heading, Vue Component No column in the parent table. display_fieldtypes no_value_fields minus Table and Table MultiSelect Layout and display only. table_fields Table, Table MultiSelect Rows are stored in the child DocType table. numeric_fieldtypes Currency, Int, Long Int, Float, Percent, Check Numeric values. float_like_fields Float, Currency, Percent Decimal values with precision. datetime_fields Datetime, Date, Time Date and time values. attachment_fieldtypes Attach, Attach Image Values are file URLs. data_field_options Email, Name, Phone, URL, Barcode, IBAN Allowed options of a Data field.

docs.title: Fieldtypes with a column
docs.text:
VARCHAR_LEN is 140 (frappe/database/database.py).

Fieldtype MariaDB Postgres SQLite Options Data varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT Empty, or one of Email, Name, Phone, URL, Barcode, IBAN. These validate and format the value. Link varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT Required. Name of the linked DocType. Dynamic Link varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT Required. Fieldname of a Link field with options DocType, or of a Select field, in the same DocType. That field holds the target DocType. Select varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT List of values, one per line. A default must be one of them. Autocomplete varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT List of suggestions, one per line. Read Only varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT Not used. Use fetch_from to fill the value. Password text text TEXT Not used. The value is encrypted in the __Auth table. The column holds a mask. Color varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT Not used. Icon varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT Emojis adds emojis to the picker. Phone varchar(140) varchar(140) TEXT Not used. The control has a country code picker. Int int(11) int INTEGER Not used. Long Int bigint(20) bigint INTEGER Not used. Not in the DocField fieldtype list. An Int field with length above 11 gets this column. Check tinyint(4) smallint INTEGER Not used. Value is 0 or 1. Float decimal(21,9) decimal(21,9) REAL Not used. Set precision for decimals. Currency decimal(21,9) decimal(21,9) REAL Fieldname that holds the currency, or DocType:link_field:currency_field to read the currency from a linked document. Percent decimal(21,9) decimal(21,9) REAL Not used. Rating decimal(3,2) decimal(3,2) REAL Number of stars, 3 to 10. Default 5. The value is stored as a fraction from 0 to 1. Duration decimal(21,9) decimal(21,9) REAL Not used. The value is in seconds. Use the hide_days and hide_seconds properties. Date date date DATE Optional JSON object of datepicker options. Datetime datetime(6) timestamp TIMESTAMP Optional JSON object of datepicker options. Time time(6) time(6) TIME Not used. Small Text text text TEXT Not used. Text text text TEXT Not used. Long Text longtext text TEXT Not used. Text Editor longtext text TEXT Not used. Rich text (Quill). The value is HTML. Markdown Editor longtext text TEXT Not used. The control sets the language to Markdown. HTML Editor longtext text TEXT Not used. The control sets the language to HTML. Code longtext text TEXT Editor language: Javascript or JS, Python or Py, PythonExpression, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Markdown, JSON, Golang or Go, Jinja, SQL. JSON json json TEXT Not used. Attach text text TEXT Not used in DocType JSON. The value is the file URL. Attach Image text text TEXT Not used. Only image files are allowed. Set it as image_field of the DocType to show it in the form header. Signature longtext text TEXT Not used. The value is a base64 image. Barcode longtext text TEXT Optional JSON object of JsBarcode options. The value is the SVG of the barcode. Geolocation longtext text TEXT Not used. The value is GeoJSON.

docs.title: Fieldtypes without a column
docs.text: Fieldtype Options Notes Table Required. A child DocType (istable = 1). Rows are stored in the child table with parent, parenttype and parentfield. A virtual DocType needs a virtual child table. Table MultiSelect Required. A child DocType with at least one Link field. Shows the rows as pills of the first Link field. Section Break Not used. Starts a section. Column Break Not used. Starts a column in a section. Tab Break Not used. Starts a tab. Fold Not used. Hides the rest of the form behind a "Show more" link. Only one per form, and it must be before a Section Break. Heading Not used. Shows the label as a heading. HTML HTML to show. Form scripts can set the content with frm.get_field(fieldname).$wrapper.html(...). Image Fieldname that holds the image URL. Shows the image of that field. Button Optional. Name of a controller method. A click runs the form script event of the field. If there is none and options is set, it calls the controller method through run_doc_method. The source marks this path as deprecated. Attachment Gallery Not used. Shows attachments of the document. Its link_filters must target File. Vue Component Required. Name of a UI island on the site. Mounts the island in the form. See Islands.

docs.title: How a column is built
docs.text:
get_definition() in frappe/database/schema.py turns a DocField into a column type:

  • Currency, Float and Percent get decimal(length, precision) on MariaDB and Postgres. The default is decimal(21,9). precision must be from 1 to 6. precision cannot be greater than length.
  • A length on a varchar field changes the size. Values below 64 become 64. SQLite stores these fields as TEXT, so length has no effect there.
  • An Int field with length above 11 becomes Long Int (bigint). On MariaDB, a length below 11 sets int(length).
  • A Link to a DocType with autoname = "UUID" gets a uuid column.
  • Check, Int, Currency, Float and Percent are NOT NULL. Their default is 0 if none is set.
  • not_nullable = 1 makes other columns NOT NULL.
  • unique = 1 adds a unique constraint, except for text and longtext columns.

docs.title: Validation rules
docs.text:
validate_fields() in frappe/core/doctype/doctype/doctype.py checks these rules when you save a DocType:

Rule Fieldtypes Options must be a valid DocType Link, Table, Table MultiSelect Options must be a child table Table, Table MultiSelect Can be unique Data, Link, Read Only, Int only Cannot have search_index Text, Long Text, Small Text, Code, Text Editor Cannot be mandatory no_value_fields except Table and Table MultiSelect Not allowed in_list_view no_value_fields. In a child table, Button and HTML are allowed. Not allowed in_global_search no_value_fields Default must be 0 or 1 Check Precision from 1 to 6 Float, Currency, Percent Options from 3 to 10 Rating Hidden and mandatory needs a default All

docs.title: Desk controls
docs.text: Each fieldtype has a control class frappe.ui.form.Control<Fieldtype> without spaces, for example ControlDynamicLink. The files are in frappe/public/js/frappe/form/controls/. Dialogs and web forms use the same controls. Some controls exist only for dialogs and filters: MultiCheck, MultiSelect, MultiSelectList, MultiSelectPills, DateRange, Switch and Comment.

docs.title: User Guide
docs.text:
Use and administer the desk: navigation, users and permissions, customization, automation, reports, website and system administration.

Topic What it covers Desk Basics Move around the desk and work with lists, views, forms, search and collaboration tools. Users and Permissions Manage users and roles, role permissions and user permissions. Customization Change forms and fields without code, and define document workflows. Automation and Email Automate work with rules, notifications, email and automation flows. Data, Reports and Printing Import and export data, run reports, build dashboards and print documents. Website and Integrations Publish web pages and web forms, and connect Frappe to other services. AI and App Builder Use Flow AI agents and build apps in Studio. System Administration Configure the system, take backups and monitor logs and jobs.

docs.title: AI and App Builder
docs.text:
Use Flow AI agents and build apps in Studio.

Page What it covers Flow Chat with AI agents that work on your Frappe site, connect a model provider, and set up agents, tools, skills, knowledge, memories and triggers. Studio Build web apps on a Frappe site with Studio, a visual editor with drag and drop components, data sources, variables, scripts and one-click publish.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text:
Flow is an AI assistant inside your Frappe site. You chat with an agent. The agent uses tools to read and change records, run reports, call APIs and search the web, with your permissions. Use Flow to ask questions about your data, do repeated work in plain language, or run an agent on a schedule or when a document changes. Flow needs a model provider, such as Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, and an API key from that provider.

Warning

Flow is in beta and can make mistakes. Flow sends your messages and the data its tools read to the model provider you connect.

docs.title: Open Flow
docs.text:
• Go to /flow for the full page. Guests are sent to the login page.
  • In the desk or in Studio, press Ctrl+I (Cmd+I on macOS) to open Flow in a side panel. The panel shows to users who can read Flow Session, also before a provider is connected.

The left sidebar has New chat, Search and your earlier chats. The Flow menu at the top has Apps, Settings (Cmd+,) and Log out.

docs.title: Connect a provider
docs.text:
Before anyone can chat, a System Manager connects a provider and picks a model.

  1. Open /flow.
  2. Under Choose a provider, select Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Click More providers for OpenRouter, Grok, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cerebras and Custom provider.
  3. Create a key at the provider and paste it in API key.
  4. Click Connect. Flow checks the key with the provider. A wrong key saves nothing.
  5. Pick the model that chats start with.

Custom provider connects any server that speaks the OpenAI API, such as vLLM, LM Studio or a LiteLLM proxy. Enter its address, starting with http:// or https://. The key is optional. When Ollama runs on the same server at localhost:11434, Flow also offers its models.

The first enabled model also makes the built-in agent Flow (frappe/Flow), which knows the site and the built-in tools.

docs.title: What the setup saves
docs.text:
Flow Provider (one per provider):

Field Default Description provider openai, anthropic, gemini, openrouter, xai, groq, deepseek, mistral, cerebras, custom_openai (OpenAI-compatible endpoint) or litellm_proxy. enabled 1 Turn off to stop all its models. api_key Password field. Stored encrypted. base_url For a custom endpoint or proxy.

Flow Model (one per model):

Field Default Description title Name shown in the model picker, for example "Claude Sonnet 4.6". provider Link to Flow Provider. model_id The id of the model at the provider. enabled 1 embedding 0 The model makes embeddings for knowledge search. context_window Number of tokens the model accepts. api_key, base_url Only when the model has no provider. extra_params JSON passed to the model call. roles Only users with one of these roles can use the model.

docs.title: Chat
docs.text:
1. Click New chat.
  2. Select an agent in the agent picker. The default agent is Flow.
  3. Type a request, for example "List open Sample Orders for Customer A".
  4. Attach files if the agent needs them.
  5. Send the message. Flow shows each tool call as it runs.

Pick how Flow asks before it changes data:

Mode Description Auto Default. A helper model decides which tool calls need approval. Ask for approval Asks you before each change. Auto-approve Runs everything without asking.

To use a skill in a message, type /skill:<name> or pick it in the skill picker. Only skills with User Invocable on show there.

To share a chat, click Share. Set General access to "Only people you add" or "Every Flow user", or add members. People you share with can read the chat. Only the owner can send messages.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
Open Flow > Settings.

Tab What you set General Theme, Show each step separately, Helper model, Web search service, Guest messages per hour. Models Providers and models. Add a model, change a key, or delete a provider. Agents The agents users can chat with. Skills Instructions agents can load for specific tasks. Tools Actions agents can take. Triggers Run an agent when a document changes or on a schedule. Knowledge Knowledge bases and their sources. Memories What agents remember.

Flow Settings fields:

Field Default Description small_model (Helper model) Does side jobs such as chat titles and approvals in Auto mode. A cheaper model saves credits. search_provider DuckDuckGo DuckDuckGo, Brave, Tavily or Exa. search_api_key Needed for every search provider except DuckDuckGo. guest_messages_per_hour 0 Messages one address can send to public agents in an hour. 0 uses the default of 30.

docs.title: Agents
docs.text:
An agent is a Flow Agent record.

Field Default Description title Agent name. model Flow Model the agent uses. instructions The system prompt. tools Flow Tool records the agent can call. sub_agents Other agents this agent can hand work to. skills Flow Skill records the agent can load. knowledge_bases Knowledge bases the agent can search. max_iterations 100 Most model turns in one run. token_budget Most tokens in one run. roles Only users with one of these roles can chat with the agent. public 0 Guests can chat with the agent without a login.

Records with System Generated set come from an app. Their greyed-out fields cannot be changed.

docs.title: Tools, skills and knowledge
docs.text:
• Tools (Flow Tool): the built-in tools have names such as frappe/read_records, frappe/create, frappe/update, frappe/run_report and frappe/web_search. A Script tool runs sandboxed Python with a main(...) function. An Imported tool points to a Python function in Import Path. Turn on Requires Confirmation to always ask before it runs.
  • Skills (Flow Skill): a name, a one-line Description of when it applies, and Instructions. Available to All Agents offers it to every agent.
  • Knowledge (Flow Knowledge Base with Flow Knowledge Source rows): a source is Text, File, URL or DocType. A DocType source can Auto Sync when records change. Set the Embedding Model in Flow Knowledge Settings first. Search is Hybrid by default, with chunk size 1000 and overlap 200.
  • Memories (Flow Agent Memory): notes an agent keeps, for the agent or for one user.

docs.title: Triggers
docs.text:
A trigger runs an agent without a chat.

  1. Open Settings > Triggers and add a trigger.
  2. Select the Agent.
  3. Set Event to DocType Event or Scheduled.
  4. For DocType Event, select the Target DocType and the Doc Event (after_insert, on_update, on_submit, on_cancel or on_trash).
  5. For Scheduled, enter a Cron Expression. Flow checks due triggers every 5 minutes.
  6. Optional: enter a Python Condition. It gets doc and utils.
  7. Write the Prompt Template. It is Jinja with doc and now.
  8. Save.
A new Sample Order {{ doc.name }} came in from {{ doc.customer_name }}.
Check the items and add a comment if a rate is missing.

The trigger runs as the Run As user, or as its owner. It skips documents that user cannot read. Trigger chats approve tool calls on their own. Each run is a Flow Run with status Running, Paused, Completed, Denied or Failed.

docs.title: Access
docs.text:
Role Can do System Manager Connect providers, manage models, agents, tools, skills and triggers. See trigger and guest chats. Flow User Chat with agents they may use, read models and skills, and manage their own triggers.

Chats, runs and personal memories are private to their owner. Roles on an agent or a model limit who can use it.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Define agents, tools and triggers in Python with frappe.flow.Agent and the @tool decorator, and register them with the flow_agents, flow_tools and flow_triggers hooks. See Flow Development.
  • Agents run in the Flow server daemon. Manage it with bench flow-server setup, start, serve, stop, restart and status.
  • Flow adds its launcher to the desk, to Studio and to apps with a route in add_to_apps_screen (frappe/flow/launcher.py, an after_request step).

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Without an enabled model, /flow shows only the provider setup. Users who cannot connect a provider see "An admin needs to connect a provider first."
  • Auto-approve lets the agent change data without asking. Use it only with agents and tools you trust.
  • A public agent answers guests. Give it only read tools and limit Guest messages per hour.

docs.title: Studio
docs.text: Studio is a visual app builder in Frappe. You build pages from components with drag and drop, connect them to Frappe data, and publish them as a web app on your site. Use Studio for a portal, an internal tool or a small app that needs its own UI, without a separate frontend project. Studio is in beta.

docs.title: Core concepts
docs.text:
Name DocType What it is App Studio App A web app served at /<app route>. It has one or more pages. Page Studio Page One screen of the app, at /<app route>/<page route>. Holds the block tree, data sources, variables and a page script. Component Studio Component A reusable part of the UI that you make in the app. Data source Studio Page Resource Data a page loads: a list of documents, one document, or an API call. Variable Studio Page Variable Page state of type String, Number, Boolean or Object.

An app is Custom (stored in the database, edited on any site) or Standard (exported to files in a Frappe app, edited in developer mode).

docs.title: Open Studio
docs.text: Go to /studio. The home page lists your apps. Filter them with All, Standard and Custom, or search by name.

docs.title: Make an app
docs.text:
1. Click New App.
  2. Enter a Title, for example "Sample Orders App".
  3. Optional: enter an App Route and an App Name. By default both come from the title, for example sample-orders-app.
  4. Click Create.

Studio makes the app and a first page, and opens the editor at /studio/app/<app>/<page>.

docs.title: The editor
docs.text: Area What it does Top bar Page title and route. Click it to change Page Title, Page Route, Tab Title and Allow Guest Access. Preview and Publish Page are at the right. Left rail Pages, Add Component, Layers, Data, Code and AI Assistant. Canvas The page. Switch between desktop, tablet and mobile, and zoom. Right panel Properties, Styles and Events of the selected block. For a text block, the props show at the top of Styles and there is no Properties tab.

docs.title: Add components
docs.text:
1. Click Add Component in the left rail.
  2. Find a component in Standard or Custom. Standard groups include Core (Text Block, Repeater, Variants, HTML, Header, Image View) and Frappe UI (Button, Alert, Badge, charts, List and more).
  3. Drag the component onto the canvas.
  4. Select it and set its props in the Properties tab. For a text block, use Props in the Styles tab.

Use Layers to see and select blocks in a tree. Use Visibility Condition in the right panel to show a block only when an expression is true.

docs.title: Connect data
docs.text:
1. Click Data in the left rail.
  2. Click Add Data Source.
  3. Enter a Data Source Name.
  4. Select the Type: Document List, Document or API Resource.
  5. For a document type, select the Document Type, the fields and filters.
  6. For API Resource, enter the URL, the method and the parameters.
  7. Save the data source. Bind block props to it.

Click Add Variable to add page state. Read and set variables in events and in the page script.

docs.title: Scripts
docs.text: Click Code to write the page script and app files. A custom app can use .js, .json and .css files and import vue, vue-router, pinia and frappe-ui.

docs.title: Preview and publish
docs.text:
• Preview opens the page at /dev/<app route>/<page route>. It shows your draft and needs a login.
  • Publish Page publishes the current page and opens it at /<app route>/<page route>.
  • The arrow next to Publish Page has Revert Changes (shows when a published page has a draft), Publish App (all pages), Unpublish Page and Unpublish App.

An app is live when at least one page is published. Published apps also show on the apps screen of the desk. A guest can open a page only when it is published and Allow Guest Access is on. Other guests go to the login page.

docs.title: AI Assistant
docs.text: The AI Assistant in the left rail builds or changes pages from a prompt. It needs an OpenRouter API key in Studio Settings (ai_api_key), set from the Studio settings dialog. When Flow is set up, the panel can also open Flow.

docs.title: Access
docs.text: Users with the System Manager or Studio User role can create and edit Studio apps. A user needs write permission on Studio App and Studio Page to edit an app.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Export an app with Export App (developer mode only) to make it standard. The files go to <frappe_app>/studio/<studio_app>/.
  • Run bench --site <site> watch-studio beside bench start to sync file changes of a standard app.
  • Add boot data for an app with the studio_app_boot hook. Frappe serves Studio apps through the page_renderer hook.
  • See Studio Development and skills/studio-app-building/SKILL.md in the frappe repo.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• A standard app can be saved only in developer mode.
  • A custom app cannot use .ts or .vue files or npm packages. Export the app if you need them.
  • Editor changes are saved as a draft (draft_blocks). Publishing copies the draft to blocks, which the live page shows.
